Choose the rank of a non-negative CP decomposition

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity_downstream.R
select_cp_rank.Rd

Fit fit_nonnegative_cp() n_init times for every rank (seed seed + 1000 * rank + run). Among ranks whose factor stability reaches stability_threshold (all ranks if none does), the smallest rank whose mean error is within 10% of the error range from the minimum is chosen.

Usage

select_cp_rank(
  y,
  ranks = 2:6,
  n_init = 2L,
  seed = 1L,
  max_iter = 30L,
  tol = 1e-04,
  stability_threshold = 0.8,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

y

Non-negative three-way array.

ranks

Candidate ranks.

n_init

Number of initialisations per rank.

seed

Base seed.

max_iter, tol

Passed to fit_nonnegative_cp().

stability_threshold

Minimum stability.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over fits.

Value

A list with summary, chosen_rank, best_fits (per rank), all_fits and jobs.
